criteria.rationale: All quantities, customer names, item descriptions, weight-based carrier selections, costs, and savings in the deliverable match the source documents and observable tool trace. The deliverable properly applies the operative approved Freight flat rate of $150 from revision 2 (record-17.txt and Shipping parameters.xlsx) and explicitly rejects the unapproved draft rate of $110 from revision 3 (record-22.txt) in accordance with registry.txt. All individual and total cost and savings calculations are arithmetically accurate, and missing data such as tracking numbers and the exact manifest date are transparently noted as blank or inferred rather than fabricated.

criteria.consequence: None; all authority rules and source figures are accurately applied.
criteria.counterevidence: None found; while record-22.txt states a $110 Freight rate, registry.txt confirms it is an unapproved draft and therefore not operative.
